mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the append-only fact lets the model invent two distinct operations producing the same AuditEntry — i.e., an audit row has been overwritten. The injection forces such a sharing to exist, which is exactly what the AppendOnly assertion is supposed to catch.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AppendOnlyViolation { some disj op1, op2: Operation | some (op1.producesAudit & op2.producesAudit) }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the ownership-conditional fact lets a member successfully PATCH a task they do not own. The injection materialises that exact escalation, which the OwnershipBasedAccess assertion must reject.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_NonOwnerMemberEdit { some op: Operation | op.outcome = SuccessOutcome and op.opKind = PatchTask and op.callerRole = MemberRole and some op.target and op.target.owner != op.caller }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the cross-team fact lets a caller succeed on a task that belongs to a different team than their X-Team-Id. The injection forces a successful cross-tenant access, which is exactly the SaaS-multi-tenancy leak NoInformationLeakage forbids.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_CrossTeamLeak { some op: Operation | some op.target and some op.callerTeam and op.target.taskTeam != op.callerTeam and op.outcome = SuccessOutcome }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the auth-boundary fact lets an unauthenticated operation produce any outcome other than UnauthenticatedOutcome (e.g., NotFound or ValidationError). The injection forces such a non-Unauth outcome to exist with no caller, which the AuthRequiredEverywhere assertion is meant to forbid.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_NoAuth { some op: Operation | no op.caller and op.outcome != UnauthenticatedOutcome }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing the permission-matrix fact leaves PermMatrix.Allowed unconstrained. The injection deletes the MemberRole→GetAudit cell, breaking FR-017 (members must be able to read audit) and PermissionCompleteness (every documented cell must be present).
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_MatrixHole { MemberRole -> GetAudit not in PermMatrix.Allowed }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the one-audit-per-save fact lets a successful PATCH leave no audit entry behind. The injection materialises that exact gap, which the AuditCompleteness assertion is meant to catch.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_NoAuditOnEdit { some op: Operation | op.outcome = SuccessOutcome and op.opKind = PatchTask and no op.producesAudit }
